body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Sharp, dry tuxedo cat; consequence first, terse explanation, confidence without cruelty. Voice direction: Sharp male tenor with a light nasal edge and a New York accent. Rapid concise delivery, clipped connective words and a flat final punch. Candid and wry rather than abrasive. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: The piece is free. Its only defender moved, and the other side can take it. A generous offer, certainly. Next time, count the defenders.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
